contract: init, begin, add, and end persist. end prepares commit or abort and does not complete it.
The opposite decision after prepare is INVALID_TXN_STATE. finish records completion and a repeat is the same outcome.
A stale coordinator epoch cannot finish. Reopen restores the prepared transaction and the new coordinator epoch.
A later init bumps the producer epoch. The old epoch is PRODUCER_FENCED and does not complete the new epoch.
limits: This is not the InitProducerId, AddPartitionsToTxn, or EndTxn RPC.
Transaction markers and read_committed visibility stay on KL11-25.
The journal format is the local PLTXNC01 record, not an Apache transaction log.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
